title: Theological Theses (De Theologia tip)
author: Louis Le Blanc de Beaulieu
edition: Theses theologicae (London: Moses Pitt, 1675). ESTC R17887; Wing L802. IA bub_gb_eOkHAW4G0-wC. Tip: De Theologia I-VII.
blurb: Louis Le Blanc de Beaulieu — opening of the Sedan Theological Theses On Theology, newly rendered from the 1675 London Latin. Tip covers theses I-VII only; the rest of the collected theses remains.
era_note: Le Blanc wrote in the mid-seventeenth century as Reformed professor at the Academy of Sedan. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1675 Pitt folio is Public Domain Mark 1.0. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.
first_english_note: No complete public-domain English of this 1675 Latin was locked. A 2024 AI English of the 1683 third edition exists; it is modern and was not used. This is a new rendering from locked Latin for the De Theologia tip only.

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1675 Pitt Latin of De Theologia I-VII, reconstructed from the Internet Archive OCR of that folio. The same OCR was used as a check of the reconstruction. The 1683 third edition was not used as copy-text. No modern English was copied.

witnesses.name: Internet Archive DjVu OCR of the 1675 Pitt folio
